saved_model.scaler_fit: Training prefix only for Ridge/ElasticNet and ARIMAX exog; no global scaling for XGB.
saved_model.context_storage: Last720 completed hourly rows saved for standalone fixed-origin prediction; operational new-history input is not implemented.

importance.permutation: Shuffle whole24-hour feature blocks across seven chronological holdout days, preserving hour phase; five repeats per group.
importance.caution: Correlated groups can substitute; negative differences indicate noise/harm in this diagnostic. This is association and conditional predictive reliance, not causality.

input_scope: Past aggregate, known calendar, optional module/sensor history according to selected group. Future sensor readings unavailable.
importance_note: Top20 chosen only by training gain/absolute standardized coefficient; seven later March days diagnose permutation reliance. No HPO/config changes. Weak/negative deltas do not establish causal sensor effects.
